Após o pagamento, as inscrições têm de ser aprovadas manualmente antes de aparecerem na lista de inscritos. • Se és associado da APS tens direito a um desconto exclusivo de 20%, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2026#72891-associados-aps-aps-associates). • **Notice of filming:** Be aware that filming and photography at the Portugal Championship 2026 will be prevelant, you therefore consent to your image being used by APS in their social media platforms by attending. • Attention your registration is only confirmed after payment has been made. After payment, registrations must be manually approved before appearing on the registration list. • If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an exclusive 20% discount, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2026#72891-associados-aps-aps-associates).

items.information: **ATENÇÃO**: Esta é uma competição da FMC com sedes simultâneas. Para facilitar a organização, ao se inscrever, deverá indicar nos comentários a qual sede irá comparecer. **NÃO SERÃO ACEITAS inscrições sem indicação da sede nos comentários**. Além disso, recomendamos que verifique o limite de competidores da sua sede. Se quiser mudar de sede após concluir a inscrição, **escreva-nos por e-mail**. **ATTENTION**: This is an FMC competition with multiple locations. In order to make the organisers' job easier, you must write which location you will be attending in the registration comments. **Registrations without a specified location WILL NOT BE APPROVED**. We also recommend that you check your location's competitor limit. If you want to change your location once you have registered, **please email us**. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAwNTA4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c1e52ca201bf2e27a201cec0ac3e80a04a11dc01/logo_final_aps.png)
